method: Complete reads of two pinned reference implementations; verified Git blob and SHA256. No BLAKE2X runtime execution in this audit.
findings: BLAKE2xb init limits declared output to1..2^32-1 and BLAKE2xs to1..65535; all-ones length acts as unknown-length sentinel. Ordinary final requires exact declared length; sentinel final accepts any nonzero output size.

Final rejects null/wrong-length output before finalizing root; propagates underlying root final failure, so repeated final is refused through consumed root state despite TODO comments about invalidation. This differs from unchecked leaf finalization in parallel variants.

Expansion creates per-block parameter domains with node offsets, full-width inner digests and final short block length. Intermediate key_length resets0 and fanout/depth reset0; result is not a prefix of a sequential BLAKE2 digest.

Output loop index is size_t but node_offset serialized32-bit. Sentinel mode lacks an explicit maximum output-block count check, so very large requests can eventually wrap serialized offset. Not allocated or executed here.

Successful final clears root/temp parameters/state; early errors inside expansion return before those clear calls. Selftests again require absent blake2-kat.h, so source inclusion does not prove vector execution.
limits: No independent XOF oracle, huge-output allocation or performance run.
162/289 blobs reviewed; native pHash/ASAN item remains skipped.
